title: Test definition
purpose: Define one analyte by one method version in one matrix, with its unit and optional default reporting limit. Receipt requests and analytical work refer to this definition.

items.label: Method
items.description: Required exact version. Creation offers active methods; editing also retains its current method even when inactive. Labels include code, version and title.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Required existing analyte, sorted by name and labeled with CAS number when present.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Required Water, Wastewater or Soil. A method version/analyte/matrix combination may occur only once.

sections.title: Reporting and availability
paragraphs: Any referring record, including QC or policy configuration, locks Method, Analyte, Matrix and Unit. Default reporting limit and availability remain editable with a reason. Existing result revisions keep their applied limit. Create a separate definition when a locked identity must differ.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Required, up to 40 characters. Suggestions combine existing spellings and common examples. Text is trimmed and stored without conversion; use consistent spelling.

items.label: Default reporting limit
items.description: Optional exact positive decimal in the unit above. At most 8 decimal places within 20 total digits. Blank means set per result. Each result preserves its applied limit.

items.label: Active (available for new work)
items.description: Checked initially. New receipt requires both this flag and the method version flag.

sections.title: Saving and history
paragraphs: A record changed since opening cannot be overwritten. Submitted input remains on the error page; reload and compare current values before re-entering the intended change. Records are retained rather than deleted.

items.label: Create / Save changes
items.description: Only administrators submit. Creation is audited; an existing change records before/after values and requires a reason. An unchanged submission returns to the list with No changes to save and adds no edit event.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Existing records only: explain any changed value or availability decision.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the corresponding list without saving.

items.label: What depends on this
items.description: Counts referring records. Methods/analytes also show active tests out of all tests. These facts can include more dependencies than list work counts.

items.label: Locked values
items.description: Dependent identity values become read-only facts with lock reasons. Locks are rechecked when saving, including concurrent references.

items.label: History
items.description: The newest 20 audit events appear in chronological order with actor, timestamp and reason.
